div.div:
فُلَانٌ أَوْلَى بِكَذَا
Such a one is more, or most, entitled to such a thing; has a better, or the best, right, or title, or claim, to it; is more, or most, deserving, or worthy, of it; is more, or most, competent to it; is more, or most, fit for it; syn. أَحَقُّ بِهِ. (Msb.) But see أَحَقٌّ. See also an ex. voce أُولُو, from the Kur, viii., last verse, and xxxiii. 6. ―
-b2- أَوْلَى بِشَىْءٍ More worthy, or deserving, of a thing. More fit, apt, or proper, for a thing. ―
-b3- بِالطَّرِيقِ لِأَوْلَى A fortiori: see طَرِيقٌ.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
